name: HardSwishQ8
adaptation: Apply hard-swish independently to eight signed INT16 Q8.8 lanes. For a raw lane X set T=min(1536,max(0,X+768)). The output raw integer is nearest(X*T/1536), with exact half values away from zero. Compute the product exactly and round once; do not round the gate first. This is x*clip(x/6+1/2,0,1) in Q8.8. Every output fits signed INT16; there is no wrap or saturation. Values below -3 map to zero, and values above +3 pass through.
